title: Relationships between periodontitis and inflammatory bowel disease: Screening and functional analysis of endoplasmic reticulum stress-related biomarkers.
authors: Huang, Yongling; Chen, Zhimin; Liang, Hongling
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过数据挖掘和机器学习筛选牙周炎与炎症性肠病的内质网应激相关生物标志物，属于纯转录组表达分析和疾病关联研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或三维结构建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the relationship between periodontitis (PD) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), focusing on changes in the expression of endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS)-related genes and the screening of potential biomarkers. PD and IBD significantly affect global health, and current treatments have limitations. This study systematically screened core ERS-related genes through data mining of the Gene Expression Omnibus database, combined with differential expression gene analysis, functional enrichment analysis, and machine learning algorithms, and constructed a diagnostic model. We identified 208 differentially expressed genes shared between PD and IBD; of these, 19 were ERS-related upregulated genes, particularly XBP1 and FOS, which demonstrated good sensitivity and specificity for diagnosing PD and IBD. Functional enrichment analysis showed that these genes mainly participated in intracellular signal transduction, immune responses, and other biological pathways, suggesting that ERS plays a significant role in PD and IBD pathology. Immune infiltration analysis revealed significant differences in immune cell composition between PD and IBD, further supporting the key role of ERS in the regulation of immune responses. The identified core genes lay the foundation for improved understanding of the PD-IBD relationship and their pathological mechanisms, offering a broad prospect for future biomarker development and clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨牙周炎（periodontitis, PD）与炎症性肠病（inflammatory bowel disease, IBD）之间的关系，重点关注内质网应激（endoplasmic reticulum stress, ERS）相关基因表达的变化及潜在生物标志物的筛选。PD和IBD显著影响全球健康，且现有治疗方法存在局限性。本研究通过对Gene Expression Omnibus数据库的数据挖掘，结合差异表达基因分析、功能富集分析和机器学习算法，系统筛选了核心ERS相关基因，并构建了诊断模型。我们识别出PD和IBD共有的208个差异表达基因；其中，19个为ERS相关上调基因，特别是XBP1和FOS，在诊断PD和IBD方面表现出良好的敏感性和特异性。功能富集分析显示，这些基因主要参与细胞内信号转导、免疫应答等生物通路，提示ERS在PD和IBD病理中发挥重要作用。免疫浸润分析揭示了PD和IBD之间免疫细胞组成的显著差异，进一步支持ERS在免疫应答调控中的关键作用。所识别的核心基因为深入理解PD-IBD关系及其病理机制奠定了基础，为未来生物标志物开发和临床应用提供了广阔前景。
